note: Whole-aquarium and renderer readings for every seed; the per-fish table for the first seed, as rows under fishColumns. Frame timelines are not kept - they are regenerated into .audit-output/interaction-observation.json.

scenarios.label: Open-water tap
scenarios.describe: One tap at mid-depth, the plainest thing a viewer can do.

scenarios.label: Substrate tap
scenarios.describe: A tap on the sand, where the touch bubble burst is released.

scenarios.label: Tap beside a plant
scenarios.describe: A tap in the canopy of the tallest specimen, which already bends to touch.

scenarios.label: Repeated taps
scenarios.describe: Five taps at the same point, 0.6 s apart - the way a child tests a thing.

scenarios.label: Mature aquarium tap
scenarios.describe: The same tap in a ten-year tank: full roster, full plants, most to repaint.

scenarios.label: New aquarium tap
scenarios.describe: The founder fish and a quarter school - the aquarium every viewer meets first.

scenarios.label: Night tap
scenarios.describe: The same tap at 02:00, when motion is slowed and the palette is inverted.

scenarios.label: Tap during feeding
scenarios.describe: A tap beside a fish that chose to work the sand.

scenarios.label: Tap during a chase
scenarios.describe: A tap beside two fish already in a chase.

scenarios.label: Tap during rest
scenarios.describe: A tap beside a resting fish - the interaction most able to feel like a shove.

scenarios.label: Tap during bubble investigation
scenarios.describe: A tap beside a fish following a bubble it found by itself.

scenarios.label: Two-point tap
scenarios.describe: Two presses 0.4 s apart, half the tank between them.

scenarios.label: Two fingers at once
scenarios.describe: A second finger placed while the first is down. It is not the primary pointer.

scenarios.label: Hold
scenarios.describe: A press held for 1.6 s. Everything after the press is inert today.

scenarios.label: Slow drag
scenarios.describe: A finger drawn across mid-water over 3 s.

scenarios.label: Fast swipe
scenarios.describe: The same path in 0.3 s.
